label: Cover
when: a banner or hero: a headline and text over a background picture, with an optional button
rules: A banner of text over a picture, a block of a section. Picture only from "The site's media library": "url" is its exact address and "id" its ID; the img has the same src, alt="" and class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-<ID>". The example's address is a stand-in without an id: replace it; if none fits, write no cover. Overlay: "overlayColor" contrast or primary, "dimRatio" 50 to 80 in tens; the span after the img has has-<slug>-background-color, has-background-dim-<dimRatio> (none at 50) and has-background-dim. Inside: heading, paragraph, spectra/buttons. No other attributes.
example:
Bikes fixed while you wait

Bring it in before ten and ride it home tonight.
